_meta.description: NSE India Cash Equity Trading Cost Schedule & Statutory Rates
_meta.notes: Verified against official circulars and statutes

rates.exchange_circular: NSE/FA/73061 (issued 27 Feb 2026, effective 1 Mar 2026: transaction 306.99 + IPFT 0.01 = 307/cr)
rates.sebi_regulation: SEBI (Stock Brokers and Sub-Brokers) Regulations (₹10 per crore)
rates.stt_statute: Finance Act 2004 as amended by Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 (0.1% on delivery buy and sell)
rates.stamp_duty_statute: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 amended by Finance Act 2019 (0.015% on buy only)
rates.gst_statute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017 (18% on Brokerage + Exchange + SEBI)
rates.stcg_statute: Section 111A of Income-tax Act (20% on short-term capital gains held <= 12 months)
rates.dp_rule: Charged once per scrip per sell day; broker-specific
